item.noellesroles.crystal_ball.desc: For fortune tellers only. Right-click on the corpse and start casting for 10 seconds (stay still during the period). After completion, the time of death + random murderer clues will be revealed (choose one of three: murderer alive/dead + name, murderer role, murderer global highlight for 1 second). 50% chance of breaking, 60 seconds cooldown. If the divination object is a corpse disguised as a Deathrattle Killer, it is deemed that he stabbed himself to death with a knife.
item.noellesroles.deduction_book.desc: Only for great detectives. Right-click to open the book of reasoning to view the clues you have mastered; right-click on the corpse to deduce a characteristic of the murderer. Each page corresponds to a murderer. If there are ≥3 clues, you can click "Target Situation" to find out his location.
item.exposure.photograph_frame.desc: Special props for photographers. The price is 200 coin, and you can buy up to two times in one game. Can also be placed in Adventure mode. After placing the photo taken by the photographer into the frame, any player who passes through the frame can be teleported to the location where the photo was taken; each time they pass through, they will be blinded for 3 seconds and need to be cooled down for 3 seconds before they can pass through again. The round starts by clearing only the frames placed by the photographer.
item.noellesroles.wizard_staff.desc: For wizards only. Right-click to charge up and release magical flame arrows, which can penetrate multiple players; the same target will die after 3 seconds after accumulating 2 times. There is no cooldown before killing. After killing, it enters the same cooldown as the knife; left click to knock back the target. Explosion! When ready, the next cast is a nine-ring fireball that can pass through walls.
item.noellesroles.wizard_potion.desc: Exclusively for wizards. Use to enter vanilla item cooldown for 160 seconds, gaining 150 mana and a limited time shield. If the shield does not kill any players during the duration of the shield, 150 mana will be inverted and an additional half of the current mana will be deducted when the shield disappears/is broken.
item.trainmurdermystery.bat.desc: vanilla attack logic, left click to hit people. Unable to attack while in a wheelchair.
item.trainmurdermystery.defense_vial.des:
Desperados can directly right-click to drink to obtain a shield.
Ordinary players can right-click the tray and pour defensive potions on the tray.
The next player to take the defense potion will gain a shield after eating/drinking the item.
The shield gained this way can gain up to 1 stack.
item.noellesroles.bucket_of_h2so4.desc:
Scavenger props.
Right click on the corpse to clear it.
item.noellesroles.c4.desc: Right-click to throw. If thrown towards the player, it will be attached to the player, otherwise it will be attached to the block where it lands. C4 will make a beeping sound when it is ignited. If it is not dismantled during this period, it will explode after a few seconds, killing players within 7 blocks. The explosion can penetrate 1 block thick wall, but cannot penetrate 2 block thick wall. When the player bound to C4 dies, C4 will fall to the ground and continue to detonate according to the remaining time. When C4 is dismantled by a player other than a fitter using demolition pliers, there is a 20%% probability of detonating C4 directly.
item.noellesroles.c4_detonator.desc: Use the right button to ignite the C4 thrown in the scene. Multiple C4s can be detonated at the same time.
item.noellesroles.camera_shears.desc: Has 3 points of durability and a 30-second CD. Right-clicking the camera will disable the camera for 90 seconds.
item.noellesroles.cooked_food.desc: Cooked by chef. It has various effects after cooking.
item.noellesroles.letter.desc: When mission point perspective is turned on, you can see the item vending machine while holding the envelope.
item.noellesroles.master_key.desc: A key that can open any door. It will be blocked by the engineer's lock, but failure to pick the lock will not consume the master key. Will drop after death.
item.noellesroles.master_key_p.desc: A key that can open ordinary wooden doors. There is a limit on the number of uses. Will be blocked by Engineer's Lock.
item.noellesroles.noell_artisan_key.desc: A craftsman's key made by a locksmith. You can ignore the props and lockpicks installed on the door and lock the door directly without damaging the reinforcement props on the door. Will not drop after death
item.noellesroles.noell_key_blank.desc: Locksmith key props. Right-click to enter the key matching mini-game. Success or failure will consume 1 key embryo.
item.noellesroles.noell_paperclip.desc: Disposable door opening prop. Unlocked doors can be opened directly.
item.trainmurdermystery.iron_door_key.de: The key that can open the iron door. There is a limit on the number of uses.
item.trainmurdermystery.key.desc:
Key to open your own room.
When mission point perspective is turned on, you can see your own room door with the key.
item.starrailexpress.knife.desc: It is a melee weapon. The left button can knock people away. The right button can raise the knife for a while and then drop it to stab the player to death.
item.starrailexpress.knife.durability_hi: Limited durability mode: This knife has only %s points of durability. It will not disappear but cannot be used after it is exhausted. You need to go to the store to buy a replacement.
item.starrailexpress.bat.desc: Melee weapon, left click to attack, there is an attack interval, and connected points cannot cause damage.
item.starrailexpress.crowbar.desc: Right-clicking will permanently break the door open, which can be repaired by a locksmith using a screwdriver.
item.starrailexpress.grenade.desc: To throw a weapon, right-click to throw it and kill players within a certain range of the landing point. Long press the right button to charge up the grenade to throw it further. Grenades are blocked by player entities.
item.starrailexpress.firecracker.desc: Right click on the ground and a gunshot will sound after 15 seconds.
item.starrailexpress.revolver.desc: The most basic long-range weapon, right-click to shoot.
item.starrailexpress.derringer.desc: Only 2 scd, bullets are only restored when hitting the player/killing, this gun has no cerebellum penalty.
item.starrailexpress.sniper_rifle.desc: It has a super long range and a slower rate of fire. It needs to be loaded with Magnum bullets. It can be loaded with a multiplier scope. You can open the scope by crouching down and right-clicking. When it hits a player 50 blocks away, it will ignore the shield and kill them.
item.starrailexpress.magnum_bullet.desc: Large caliber bullets for loading sniper rifles.
item.starrailexpress.scope.desc: A scope that can be mounted on a sniper rifle.
item.starrailexpress.body_bag.desc: Disposable items to remove bodies from the ground.
item.starrailexpress.blackout.desc: When purchased, all lights in the map will be turned off.
item.starrailexpress.psycho_mode.desc: After purchasing, the killer will enter crazy mode, attack with a bat, and come with a layer of shield (except for the clown).
item.starrailexpress.poison_vial.desc: The right key can be placed in the food tray and drink tray to poison the next player with the food or drink after eating it.
item.starrailexpress.scorpion.desc: You can right-click and place it on the bed. The scorpion poison will spread the poison to the nearby beds within a certain range, poisoning the players sleeping on the bed.
item.starrailexpress.old_fashioned.desc: Old fashioned cocktails, ready to drink.
item.starrailexpress.note.desc: Notes are used to record information. Squat down and right-click to write text, and right-click to paste it on the wall.
item.noellesroles.giant_note.desc: Generate a sticky note 5 times the size that reporters can paste on others.
item.starrailexpress.nunchuck.desc: Twin sticks, weapons exclusive to martial arts instructors. For detailed tutorials, see martial arts instructor role.
item.starrailexpress.lockpick.desc: Right-click on any door to open it, and shift-right-click on the door to lock it.
item.noellesroles.a_bottle_of_water.desc: A bottle of water for drinking.
item.noellesroles.pan.desc: Pan, used for cooking food, exclusive props for Chef role.
item.noellesroles.once_revolver.desc: A revolver that can only fire once.
item.noellesroles.handcuffs.desc: Handcuffs, right-click to handcuff the player. The handcuffed player can break free by continuously squatting down.
item.noellesroles.patroller_revolver.des: The patrolman's special pistol has a very short shot cooldown.
item.noellesroles.night_vision_glasses.d: Night vision goggles are also provided when worn.
item.noellesroles.diving_helmet.desc: A diving helmet that provides underwater breathing and the boon of a dolphin when worn.
item.noellesroles.diving_boots.desc: Diving Boots, which grant Deep Sea Explorer 3 when worn.
item.noellesroles.fake_knife.desc: The fake knife looks like a real knife and can be raised, but cannot cause a kill.
item.noellesroles.yinyang_sword.desc: Black and white weapons. Left click: Black and white particles rush into 6 blocks to kill. Right click: Shake forward for 1 second to release 4 blocks of AOE to kill.
item.noellesroles.fake_revolver.desc: The fake gun, which looks like a real gun, can only fire five times and cannot cause any kills.
item.noellesroles.fake_bat.desc: A fake bat that looks like a real bat but cannot cause damage.
item.noellesroles.fake_psycho_mode.desc: Fake crazy mode, used to confuse others, exclusive to magician role.
item.noellesroles.fake_grenade.desc: The fake grenade looks like a real grenade and can pull the ring but cannot be thrown.
item.noellesroles.fake_lockpick.desc: Fake lock picking tools that look like the real thing but don't work.
item.noellesroles.fake_crowbar.desc: Fake crowbar that looks like the real thing but doesn't work.
item.noellesroles.fake_body_bag.desc: Fake body bags look like real ones but cannot contain a body.
item.noellesroles.delusion_vial.desc: Commonly known as: fake poison, players will feel that they are poisoned and cannot be killed, but they can be catalyzed to death by the catalyst.
item.noellesroles.defibrillator.desc: Defibrillator, an exclusive item of Doctor
item.noellesroles.boxing_glove.desc: Boxing gloves, an exclusive item for Fighter role. Press and hold the right button to raise the gloves, and right-click to knock back, stun, and put all items on the body on cooldown.
item.noellesroles.antidote_reagent.desc: Long press the right button to use it on a player to check whether the player is poisoned and how many times it has been used.
item.noellesroles.conspiracy_page.desc: Conspirator role exclusive props, right-click to open the page to guess role, the player who is guessed will die.
item.noellesroles.flash_grenade.desc: Flashbang, after throwing it, it will blind the player who is looking at the flashbang.
item.noellesroles.decoy_grenade.desc: Decoy bombs that keep firing after throwing.
item.noellesroles.reinforcement.desc: Repair tools, right-click on the door to make the door resist a crowbar. Crouch down and right-click to remove the props on the door.
item.noellesroles.screwdriver.desc: Screwdriver, squat down and right-click to remove the props on the door. Locksmith role can additionally use a screwdriver to restore the door to its original state (to restore the door that was broken open by a crowbar).
item.noellesroles.alarm_trap.desc: The alarm trap will sound an alarm when triggered by the crowbar, and the door of the alarm trap will lock when pressed.
item.noellesroles.delivery_box.desc: Right-click the player to allow the deliverer and the recipient to exchange items.
item.noellesroles.hallucination_bottle.d: 2 points of durability, right-click to force players within a certain range to twist their perspective 3 times.
item.noellesroles.mint_candies.desc: Restore 50% of san value after use.
item.noellesroles.written_note.desc: Recorder role exclusive props, right-click to record the player's identity
item.noellesroles.wheelchair.desc: role exclusive prop for the elderly, right-click to prevent the wheelchair from falling on the ground
item.noellesroles.lock.desc: The lock is used to lock the door. When the killer uses a lock pick to open the lock, it needs to be opened manually.
item.noellesroles.pocket_watch.desc: Pocket watch, right-click to view the in-game game time, 60 seconds cd.
item.noellesroles.adrenaline.desc: Disposable item, pharmacist role exclusive prop, right-click on the player to increase the target's physical limit by 2 points.
item.noellesroles.antibiotic.desc: Disposable items, pharmacist role exclusive props, right-click to use on players to detoxify the target
item.noellesroles.hedinghong.desc: Disposable item, exclusive item of pharmacist role, right-click on the player to poison the target.
item.noellesroles.toilet_poison.desc: Disposable items, Poison Master role exclusive props, right-click on the toilet to poison the next player sitting on the toilet.
item.noellesroles.dogskin_plaster.desc: Disposable items, pharmacist role exclusive props, right-click to use on the player, so that the target's sanity value will not be lowered within 30 seconds.
Disposable item, right-click to use on the player, and randomly apply one of the following 6 buff effects: san value consumption slowdown, san value consumption immunity, san value recovery, unlimited stamina, stamina improvement, stamina recovery efficiency improvement; and prompts the target for the current effect.
item.noellesroles.dream_axe.desc: Dream exclusive weapon, 12 points of durability, half price for the second purchase in the store. Left-click attack (the charge bar must be full): deduct the target's virtual blood volume, causing 9 points of damage with flat A, and 12 points of damage with jumping chop (attack while falling); when violent, it increases to 12/20 points, and the target will be knocked back. The player hit will be stunned for 1 second (2 seconds when violent): unable to move, unable to use skills and items, unable to open the backpack, and limited vision. Right-click to jump in place (0.2 second cooldown); when more than 3 blocks above the ground, you cannot jump and enter a 1.5 second penalty cooldown.
item.noellesroles.dream_mask.desc: Dream's exclusive ability (takes effect immediately after purchase, does not occupy the backpack). Immediately enter a berserk state after purchase (crazy logic, comes with a layer of shield): the damage of the iron ax is increased, the stun is lengthened, the attack range is +1, and players who see you nearby will get limited vision, slowness and shaking effects due to fear, and chase music will also sound during the berserk period. Cooldown 120 seconds.
item.noellesroles.dream_pickaxe.desc: Dream exclusive props. A locked door can be opened like a lock pick by directly right-clicking; sneaking + right-clicking can directly pry the door (cooling time is 50 seconds), but the door cannot be locked. The sound of breaking the door is loud and can be heard by nearby players.
item.noellesroles.dream_boat.desc: Dream exclusive props. When used on the ground, a boat will be placed, and surrounding players will be forced to get on the boat and cannot get off until the boat disappears. The boat will disappear after 10 seconds. Cooldown 60 seconds, items are not consumed.
item.noellesroles.area_blackout.desc: Dream's exclusive ability (takes effect immediately after purchase, does not occupy the backpack). Immediately after purchase, all lights within a 30-block radius centered on yourself will be extinguished, and the lights will be turned off to cause blindness. Cooling is the same as normal lights off.
item.noellesroles.dream_wine.desc: The wine that Dream brewed using his wine-making skills. After drinking it, you will become invisible for 10 seconds, during which you cannot attack or be injured.
item.noellesroles.throwing_knife.desc: Press the Q key to throw, and right-click to lift the flying knife and cause a kill.
item.noellesroles.rope.desc: An exclusive prop for Search and Rescue role. Right-click to pull a person within a straight line to you.
item.noellesroles.extinguisher.desc: The firefighter role exclusive prop has 5 points of durability. It can be sprayed on players by right-clicking or long-pressing the right button. The sprayed player will be slowed down and blinded, and can clear the gasoline poured on the body by the arsonist.
item.noellesroles.passbook.desc: An exclusive role prop for accountants. Right-click to save money on your body into a passbook (up to 300 coin). The passbook will be passed to a good person nearby when the accountant dies. The passbook can be thrown out.
item.noellesroles.alchemy_material.desc: Pharmacist's role exclusive props, used to make potions.
item.noellesroles.signature_paper.desc: Celebrity role exclusive props, you can right-click to sign, squat down and right-click to sign the certificate of life and death. For details, please see the introduction of Celebrity role.
item.noellesroles.life_and_death_shape.d: In the state of life and death, you can ask the star to resist one injury for you.
item.noellesroles.signed_paper.desc: Signature paper. Players who own the signature paper can continue to see through the star's position and gain a speed 1 effect when looking at the star.
item.noellesroles.bowen_badge.desc: Bowen Badge, an exclusive prop for Jotaro's role. Press and hold the right button for 3 seconds to sprint, killing the target you collide with and causing knockback to surrounding targets.
item.noellesroles.shisiye.desc: Maid Sakuya role exclusive props, after drinking, you will gain speed 10.
item.noellesroles.problem_set.desc: In the exercise set, right-click to start doing the questions. If you do the questions correctly, you will be rewarded, and if you fail, you will be punished.
item.noellesroles.antidote.desc: Right-click on the player to detoxify the player. After use, the player enters the CD. When there is a plague on the field, the CD will be faster.
item.noellesroles.pill.desc: Edible pills can be purchased from the doctor's store as detoxifying pills and from the poisonist's store as poison-causing pills.
item.noellesroles.toxin.desc: Disposable items, long-range weapons, right-clicking on players can poison the targeted players.
item.noellesroles.catalyst.desc: Poison Master role exclusive props, right-click to kill all players who are poisoned.
item.noellesroles.bandit_revolver.desc: Pistols used by robbers and executioners, with a shorter range.
item.noellesroles.throwing_axe.desc: Bandit's charged throwing weapon. Hold down the right button to charge for 0.8 seconds and then release the throw. The ax will fly in a straight line, penetrating and killing up to 2 players; then it will fly to the wall and be nailed, and disappear after 5 seconds. If you let go if the charge is less than 0.8 seconds, it will not fire. There is a 3-second cooldown after throwing, and the weapon itself remains in the hand and can be used repeatedly.
item.noellesroles.stalker_knife.desc: Exclusive weapons for the second stage of STALKER role. Right-click to charge and stab to kill the target. After killing, the second stage of progress will be added. Crouch and right-click to quickly charge up. Has a 10 second attack cooldown.
Exclusive weapons for the second stage of STALKER role. Right-click to charge and stab to kill the target. After killing, the second stage of progress will be added. Crouch and right-click to quickly charge up. Has a 10 second attack cooldown.
item.stupid_express.jerry_can.desc: The arsonist's role exclusive props, right-clicking will make the player douse in gasoline.
item.stupid_express.lighter.desc: Arsonist role's exclusive props will set players doused with gasoline on fire by right-clicking on them. For details, see the introduction to Arsonist role.
item.starrailexpress.camera.desc: Surveillance cameras serve the same purpose as real-life surveillance
item.starrailexpress.dark_toilet.desc: Dark toilet, task block, right click on the toilet to complete the toilet task.
item.starrailexpress.light_toilet.desc: Latent toilet, task block, right-click on the toilet to complete the toilet task.
item.starrailexpress.security_monitor.de: Security surveillance, used to observe the perspective of surveillance cameras.
item.noellesroles.monitoring_terminal.de: Remote monitoring terminal. First right-click the security monitor to bind it, and then right-click it to view the bound monitor remotely.
item.noellesroles.ninja_knife.desc: Disposable item, the ninja's melee weapon, right-click to assassinate the target immediately, silently.
item.noellesroles.ninja_shuriken.desc: Disposable item, the ninja's long-range weapon, press and hold the right button to fire, silent.
item.noellesroles.mercenary_contract.des: role is an exclusive prop for mercenaries. Others can right-click to sign an employment contract, select a target and pay 175 coin. Mercenaries can obtain employment fees by right-clicking on the signed contract and provide wanted targets for mercenaries. The contract can be thrown out by pressing the Q key.
item.noellesroles.riot_shield.desc: Security role exclusive items. The equipment can withstand a frontal attack and provide protection when the shield is held in the main hand/off hand.
item.noellesroles.baton.desc: Security role exclusive items. Melee weapon with 4 durability points. Left-click attack can stun the target. If the target is hit twice by the stick within 4 seconds, it will cause a kill.
item.noellesroles.bone_staff.desc: Lord of the Dead role exclusive items. Melee weapon with 5 durability points. Left-clicking the player can inject 24% of the infection value into the target, and each attack consumes 1 point of durability. When the target's infection value reaches full, it will be transformed into an undead.
item.noellesroles.leon_blue_herb.desc: Lyon exclusive items. Right-click to use immediately to refresh the cooldown of fighting skills. Obtained when there are only 6 players left on the field; Leon will not drop with the pistol after death.
item.noellesroles.leon_red_herb.desc: Lyon exclusive items. Press and hold the right button to use it to put a layer of shield on yourself (cannot be superimposed). Obtained when there are only 3 players left on the field; Leon will not drop with the pistol after death.
item.noellesroles.radio.desc: Right-click to use to communicate remotely with other players.
item.noellesroles.short_shotgun.desc: Disposable items. Right-click to charge and shoot, and the killing fan range will increase smoothly with charging (2-4 blocks); after the killing range reaches 3 blocks, players within the 2-block sector outside the current killing range will receive 1 point of damage and be knocked back.
item.noellesroles.executioner_gun.desc: The Fool's exclusive weapon can only cause damage to players with the "Heresy" effect (one-hit kill). The initial number of bullets is 1, and bullets can only be replenished through Tarot Club.
item.noellesroles.honored_note.desc: Purchased from the Fool's Store. Right-click the wall/floor attachment to generate an indestructible text entity. The player presses the J key to pray against the note to join the "Tarot Club members".
item.noellesroles.spirit_cloak.desc: Purchased from the Fool's Store. After right-clicking, you will be invincible for 5 seconds, unable to attack, and your movement speed will remain unchanged. Cooldown 90 seconds.
item.noellesroles.pliers.desc: With 1 point of durability, you can right-click to remove the sticky mines on C4 and the player. Demolition of C4 or sticky mines by non-fitter players will consume 1 point of durability. The use of demolition pliers by the Locksmith will not consume durability. When non-fitter players use demolition pliers to dismantle C4, there is a 20% chance of directly detonating C4.
item.starrailexpress.drawing_board.desc:
You can obtain the corresponding item by drawing its material on the artboard.
Right-click to open and paint in the painting area. When confirmed, the system will identify it based on the painting content. After successfully identifying the item, you will obtain the painting item and consume 1 drawing board.
If the item material contains white, please use white fill in the color palette. The system will not recognize the white color of the background.
If the image recognition fails, you can modify individual pixels and try a few more times. The image recognition may not be 100% standard (you may also be confused by other things when you doodle)
 
You cannot obtain the following items through artboards
- Drawing board/Grenade/Lock pick/Bat/Deringa pistol/Scorpion/Special weapons of the Sheriff’s camp (except baton)
- Pistols will only recognize revolvers, knives will only recognize ordinary knives
- Chlorine bombs/purification bombs/venom reagents/pills/hallucination potions/pans/sulfuric acid barrels/blank bombs/key embryos
- Neutral faction exclusive items/fake items/vanilla items
- Exclusive items for pharmacist/star/fool/delay ghost/photographer
- Keys other than cabin crew keys/crowbars/paper clips
item.noellesroles.zero_one_five_gun.desc: Exclusive pistol. Right click to shoot. If the first shot hits, it will grant Slow II for 3 seconds. After 1.2 seconds, the second shot will be automatically fired. If the second shot hits, it will kill directly. After two shots, it will enter a 15-second cooldown. Range 30 blocks.
item.noellesroles.wreath.desc: The wreath continues to restore sanity when worn on the head. There are 60 durability points in total. When worn, 1 durability point is consumed every second. The effect disappears after the durability is exhausted.
item.noellesroles.shilijia.desc: Stone frame, after consumption, it will immediately restore 50% of the physical strength based on the upper limit of physical strength. It can be purchased by the big goblin and distributed to teammates.
item.noellesroles.youlu_anchor.desc: Exclusive to Youlu, you can buy it once in the store for 80 coin. The first use releases a spherical anchor point that slides forward along the ground (visible only to Youlu himself). The second use uses it to teleport to the anchor point and recover the anchor point, and then enters a 30-second cooldown. Anchors last up to 25 seconds.
item.noellesroles.youlu_smoke.desc: Exclusive to Youlu, you can buy it once in the store for 70 coin. After use, a smoke wave is released along the line of sight (including up and down) that advances forward (can pass through walls, not instantaneous): Players within a radius of 4 blocks during the advancement will be blinded and darkened for 8 seconds. After the hit, the smoke will not disappear and will continue to move forward. The total distance is 12 blocks. Cooldown 60 seconds.
item.noellesroles.barbarian_knife.desc: An unbreakable Barbarian Blade granted only during Berserk Form. It has no cooldown and can attack only neutral and killer factions.
item.noellesroles.chocolate.desc: Delicious chocolate, the sanity value will not drop within a short period of time after consumption. (lasts 15 seconds)
item.noellesroles.calming_tea.desc: Calm tea, slow down the consumption of sanity after drinking. (lasts 60 seconds)
item.noellesroles.talisman.desc: Amulet, when carried in the inventory, reduces low san visual disturbance and slowly restores san value.
item.noellesroles.energizing_coffee.desc: Refreshing coffee, after drinking it, the sanity value is greatly restored and the speed is increased. (lasts 30 seconds)
item.noellesroles.cake_ingredients.desc: Right-click to disassemble it to obtain the materials needed to cook the cake.
shop.noellesroles.undead_lord.plague_fog: Releases a poisonous mist at your feet, increasing infection by +5% per second in the area for 10 seconds.
shop.noellesroles.undead_lord.summon_cha: Instantly summons 2 temporary undead nearby for 45 seconds. 60 seconds cooldown, and the number of summons will not exceed the upper limit of undead.
shop.noellesroles.undead_lord.infection_: Undead attacks have double the infection value for the next 60 seconds.
item.noellesroles.reasoner_compass.desc: Items exclusive to Reasoners. It is automatically obtained 2 minutes after the game starts. Right-click to open the compass divination interface. There will be a 35-second cooldown after each answer is submitted. If all questions are answered correctly, you can win independently.
item.noellesroles.inferior_lockpick.desc: The inferior lockpick exclusive to Wunner inherits the unlocking and closing characteristics of the lockpick; it will enter a 15-second cooldown every time it is successfully used to unlock a lock.
item.starrailexpress.dnf_cleaning_byprod: Byproduct from cleaning tasks. Can be exchanged for 1 Emerald at DNF exchange task points.
item.starrailexpress.dnf_task_tool.desc: Look at a DNF task point and hold right-click for 8 seconds to complete the task.
item.starrailexpress.dnf_cleaning_task_p: DNF cleaning task point. Use the task tool and hold right-click to clean.
item.starrailexpress.dnf_exchange_task_p: DNF exchange task point. Exchange 1 cleaning byproduct for 1 Emerald.
item.starrailexpress.dnf_toxic_heart.des: Special material obtained by Poisoner after poisoning a kill. Five are needed for the Redemption formula.
item.starrailexpress.dnf_redemption_poti: Redemption potion. Crafting two triggers an independent ending for the Chef and Poisoner.
Old diary found by the Chef at a config point, containing clues about the Old Chef, Poisoner, and Redemption Potion.
item.starrailexpress.dnf_redemption_form: Formula obtained after the Poisoner and Chef meet. Right-click to consume materials and craft two Redemption potions.
item.noellesroles.niaoshoushou_knife.des: Niaoshoushou's Nepalese kukri. Uses the normal knife attack and has 4 durability; it can also pry small doors, consuming 1 durability per successful pry.
item.noellesroles.niaoshoushou_incendiar: Niaoshoushou's incendiary grenade. Reuses the existing incendiary effect and has a 45-second cooldown.
item.noellesroles.niaoshoushou_family_ph: Niaoshoushou's family photo. Right-click two killer-team players or the Magician to form a team; only one can be bought per round.
item.noellesroles.niaoshoushou_missile.d: Niaoshoushou's cruise missile. Binds the camera after launch, follows the player's view up, down, left, and right while flying forward automatically, with A/D for fine turning. On impact it explodes, igniting players within 5 blocks and killing them after 1.5 seconds. 60-second cooldown.
